@AlipourfardEtAl2021SystematizingConfidenceOpen; @NosekEtAl2025BriefGlossaryTerms

::: notes
Here is the vocabulary of the course as a single grid, and if you take one thing home, make it this. The question stays the same throughout, and what varies is the data and the analysis. Same data and the same analysis is reproducibility: if I rerun your recipe, do I get your number? Same data but a different, justifiable analysis is robustness, which asks whether your finding survives my defensible choices. New data for the same question is replicability. The fourth cell, new data and new analysis, is really generalisation, and we leave it aside. Sit with the grid for a moment, because everything that follows refers back to it.
:::
